meta.description: Convert Year (365 d) (yr) to Day (d) instantly. 1 yr = 365 d. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert year (365 d)s (yr) to days (d) instantly. Both measure time, so the relationship is strictly linear: each year (365 d) equals 365 days. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One year (365 d) is equal to **365 days**. To go the other way, one day equals **0.002739726 year (365 d)s**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> days = year (365 d)s × 365

Worked example — converting 10 year (365 d)s:

10 × 365 = **3650 d**.

To invert, divide by 365 (or multiply by 0.002739726).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 yr ≈ 365 d. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Year (365 d) and Day both measure time; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many days are in 1 year (365 d)?
**A:** 365 days.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert yr to d?
**A:** days = year (365 d)s × 365.

**Q:** How do I convert d back to yr?
**A:** Multiply by 0.002739726 (or divide by 365).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.
